name: Native Audio Streaming Architecture
summary: Replaces a traditional 3-stage STT-LLM-TTS pipeline with a unified full-duplex WebSocket stream to a native audio LLM, eliminating multi-hop audio latency.
steps: Establish a bidirectional WebSocket connection to Gemini 2.5 Native Audio API.
Stream local microphone PCM audio directly into the input context window.
Receive concurrent audio output stream for immediate playback.
jarvis_use: Enables sub-second full-duplex voice turn-taking without processing speech through separate STT/TTS models.

name: Instant Speech Interruption Playout Flushing
summary: Detects incoming user voice activity during assistant speech output and immediately flushes the active audio playout buffer.
steps: Monitor microphone input stream for user speech activity while audio is playing.
Trigger speech interruption flag when voice threshold is exceeded.
Flush local speaker playback buffer and halt model generation.
jarvis_use: Allows the user to cut off long-winded Jarvis responses instantly mid-sentence.

name: Live Camera Multimodal Object Identification
summary: Streams webcam frame snapshots alongside voice queries into a multimodal LLM to identify physical objects held by the user in real time.
steps: Capture high-resolution snapshot from camera feed.
Pack video frame as image context alongside the voice prompt.
Send payload to multimodal Gemini endpoint for identification.
Speak object details back to user.
jarvis_use: Enables Jarvis to visually inspect physical hardware components, tools, or desk items on camera.

name: Local Subnet LAN Discovery via python-kasa
summary: Scans the local network subnet to discover smart devices via IP sockets, bypassing cloud service APIs and rate limits.
steps: Execute a subnet IP broadcast scan using python-kasa on local network.
Map discovered IP addresses to logical room device identifiers.
Store device IP map in assistant configuration file.
jarvis_use: Provides direct sub-100ms local network hardware control for smart office lights and plugs.

name: LLM Function Calling for Smart Home Control
summary: Registers custom function schemas for smart light operations with the LLM so it can autonomously invoke local socket commands when requested.
steps: Define JSON tool schemas for actions (turn_on, turn_off, cycle_lights, set_color).
Pass tool definitions into LLM system context.
Parse tool_call response from model and execute python-kasa socket code.
jarvis_use: Allows natural voice commands like 'cycle the office lights' to execute exact IoT device logic.

name: MediaPipe OpenCV Air Gesture Cursor Emulation
summary: Emulates screen mouse movement and clicking by tracking hand joint positions from a webcam feed using MediaPipe and OpenCV.
steps: Capture continuous frame feed from desktop webcam.
Pass frames to MediaPipe hand landmark tracking.
Map index finger tip position to OS screen cursor coordinates.
Trigger click/drag events when index-thumb pinch distance drops below threshold.
jarvis_use: Provides touchless, Iron Man-style gesture navigation for Jarvis desktop interfaces.

name: Gesture Cursor Sensitivity and Flip Settings
summary: Implements configurable cursor sensitivity multipliers and horizontal axis flip toggles within the UI drawer to refine gesture precision.
steps: Open Settings drawer overlay.
Adjust Cursor Sensitivity slider to scale hand-to-cursor motion ratio.
Toggle Horizontal Flip to align gesture direction with screen layout.
jarvis_use: Prevents hand fatigue and improves accuracy when using webcam gesture control.

name: Asynchronous Background Browser Subprocessing
summary: Spawns a background Gemini Computer Use process to automate browser tasks without blocking the main voice conversational loop.
steps: Receive multi-step browser task prompt from coordinator.
Spawn worker subprocess running Gemini Computer Use agent.
Open dedicated sub-window (WEB_AGENT_VIEW) displaying active agent actions.
Maintain non-blocking IPC channel back to primary voice thread.
jarvis_use: Enables Jarvis to shop or research on the web in the background while keeping voice assistant interaction responsive.

name: Human-in-the-Loop Confirmation Dialogs for Computer Actions
summary: Intercepts high-risk automated computer actions with GUI confirmation dialogs requiring human approval before execution.
steps: Detect action flagged as high-privilege (e.g. computer control, file modification).
Pause agent execution loop.
Pop up GUI confirmation prompt with details of requested action.
Proceed with action only upon explicit user approval.
jarvis_use: Protects user environment against unwanted or accidental automated operations executed by sub-agents.

name: Anti-Bot CAPTCHA Detection and Agent Pause
summary: Detects anti-bot CAPTCHA visual challenges in computer-use vision agents and halts execution to avoid policy violations.
steps: Scan viewport screenshots for CAPTCHA grid patterns.
Halt background browser process when CAPTCHA is detected.
Notify user via UI/voice to complete challenge manually.
jarvis_use: Gracefully handles anti-scraping defenses without breaking the background process state.

name: Isolated Directory Project Workspace Memory
summary: Organizes long-term conversational and file memory into discrete project folders (e.g. `project_robot_arm/`) that reload on context switch.
steps: Create isolated folder on local file system for each project.
Save raw conversation logs (history.json) inside the active project folder.
Reload transcript history and document summaries into LLM context when project context switches.
jarvis_use: Gives Jarvis persistent, context-isolated workspaces for managing separate coding or design projects.

name: Autonomous File Management Function Suite
summary: Equips the LLM with read, write, and directory management tools to maintain project documentation directly on disk.
steps: Define tools schema for read_file, write_file, create_folder, and list_folder.
Pass file management schema to LLM tool catalog.
Execute local file system IO operations upon function call trigger.
jarvis_use: Enables Jarvis to read requirements, write plans, and organize project folders on disk autonomously.

name: Hierarchical Multi-Agent CAD Generation Architecture
summary: Routes domain-specific CAD generation requests from the primary voice assistant to a specialized secondary CAD model.
steps: Detect 3D CAD design request in conversational input.
Format design requirements and dispatch to specialized CAD generator sub-agent.
Receive generated script/STL artifact back from sub-agent.
jarvis_use: Delegates heavy specialized tasks like parametric 3D modeling from the main voice coordinator to specialized sub-agents.

name: Real-Time Thinking Log UI Panel Streaming
summary: Streams and displays internal reasoning steps from thinking models directly in a visual UI panel during task execution.
steps: Capture internal reasoning tokens from LLM response stream.
Pipe thinking log text into dedicated UI panel (DESIGNER THINKING).
Update progress step count (e.g. 1/3) in real time.
jarvis_use: Provides visual feedback on sub-agent reasoning progress during long-running code or design generation.

name: Direct Moonraker API 3D Print Dispatch Pipeline
summary: Sends generated STL files directly to Moonraker API endpoints on Klipper 3D printers to initiate local slicing and automated printing.
steps: Export rendered STL file from CAD sub-agent to project folder.
Target Moonraker API endpoint (http://<printer_ip>:7125).
Upload STL and slice via server endpoint.
Issue POST request to /printer/print/start to begin physical printing.
jarvis_use: Allows Jarvis to send custom designed physical components straight to local 3D printers for automated fabrication.
